answer_1.quote: Data-to-text tasks aim to generate meaningful and coherent natural language text that faithfully conveys structured data.
answer_1.outputs: fluent and grammatical sentence that is faithful to a given AMR graph

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the results with BLEU and chrF++ metrics. We also report the meaning (M) component of the MF-score, which measures how well the source AMR graph can be reconstructed from the generated sentence. BERTScore allowing a semantic evaluation that depends less on the surface forms.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation via crowdsourcing using Amazon Mechanical Turk. We follow previous work and evaluate the meaning similarity, i.e., how close in meaning is the generated text to the reference sentence.
answer_4.guideline: annotators then rate on a 1-7 Likert scale
